info.title: API-DocTest-List Support Tickets Assigns-v4-spec
info.description: The Support Ticket Assignment Retrieval API allows users to obtain a list of currently assigned support tickets. This endpoint is particularly useful for customer service teams and support staff who need to track ticket assignments and manage workloads effectively. By retrieving this information, users can ensure that tickets are being addressed in a timely manner. Typical consumers include support agents, administrators, and reporting tools that help in monitoring ticket management performance.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of tickets that can be assigned.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch available tickets that can be assigned to agents. It provides essential information for ticket management and helps ensure that tickets are distributed efficiently among available agents.

requestBody.description: Request body for assigning a ticket. This body must include the necessary identifiers and parameters that specify which ticket is to be assigned and to whom.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the current ticket assignment is returned.

ListSupportTicketsAssignsRequest.description: A JSON string that represents the request body for assigning tickets in the GET operation.
